SELECT DISTINCT e."name", e."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE
    (LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%' OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%hall%')
    AND (e."capacity"::integer >= 200)
    OR
    (LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%conference%' OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%room%')
    AND (e."capacity"::integer >= 200);
2:
SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND "capacity" = 200;

SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" LIKE '%cafe%'
    AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" NOT LIKE '%cafe%';

SELECT DISTINCT
    its."name" AS support_specialist_name,
    s."system_name" AS system_name
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        it_support_specialists_systems itss
    JOIN
        systems s ON itss.system_id = s.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

112:
WITH internship_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total_internships
    FROM "internships"
),
responsibility_coverage AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT DISTINCT r."responsibility"
FROM responsibility_coverage r
JOIN internship_count ic ON r."internship_count" = ic."total_internships";

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
ORDER BY
    j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
263:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "salarydetails" sd
JOIN "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%';
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
266:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "minimum_years",
        "preferred_years"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    msj."minimum_years" AS required_experience_years,
    msj."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    max_salary_job msj;
